5 to 7 years of specialized leave administration experience in California along with 5 to 7 years of HR generalist experience.
Prior operational experience utilizing UCPath for HR and leave administration.
Experience in a university setting (UC preferred) or a large, highly complex organization supporting both represented and non-represented employees.

Guide departments on overall absence management and administer leaves (FMLA, CFRA, PDL, disability, and personal leaves) in compliance with university policies, collective bargaining agreements, and legal regulations.

Act as a primary liaison with Central HR on disability and workers' compensation claims, facilitating smooth communication between staff and leadership regarding leave accruals, return-to-work protocols, and workplace accommodations.

Conduct one-on-one counseling sessions to actively listen to employee circumstances, identify applicable leave and financial options, and guide individuals step-by-step through the process beyond simple paperwork processing.
Maintain accurate tracking, documentation, and reporting requirements for all ongoing and completed leave cases while monitoring compliance deliverables.
Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.
Thorough knowledge of HR functions, labor laws, employment practices, and HR management systems (HRMS) such as applicant tracking and leave administration software.
Strong interpersonal, active listening, analytical, and critical thinking skills with a proven ability to communicate effectively across diverse audiences and handle difficult situations.
